title: International software or SaaS subscription declined
shortDescription: Your attempt to pay for an international software or SaaS subscription was declined or blocked.
possibleExplanations: Possible explanation: The card issuer may restrict or decline certain international or recurring online payments.
Possible explanation: The merchant may not accept the card scheme or billing country you used.
Possible explanation: Fraud checks or geographic rules on either side may have blocked the transaction.
General information: Local payment methods are not always usable for every international merchant.

title: International digital tool or professional service payment declined
shortDescription: Payment for an international digital tool, platform, or professional service did not go through.
possibleExplanations: Possible explanation: The payment method may not be enabled for international online purchases.
Possible explanation: The service provider may only accept certain card networks or regions.
Possible explanation: Amount limits, currency, or billing-address rules may have caused a decline.
General information: Different merchants apply different acceptance rules.

title: Local card or payment method not accepted by an international merchant
shortDescription: An international website or merchant does not accept your local card or payment method.
possibleExplanations: Possible explanation: The merchant may only accept international card schemes such as Visa or Mastercard.
Possible explanation: A local-only card scheme may have limited or no acceptance outside its home market.
Possible explanation: The merchant’s payment processor may not support the card or region.
General information: Card acceptance depends on both the issuer and the merchant’s setup.

title: Education, examination, or training fee payment difficulty
shortDescription: You are having trouble paying an international education, examination, or training-related fee.
possibleExplanations: Possible explanation: The institution may only accept specific payment methods or currencies.
Possible explanation: Card or bank restrictions on international education payments may apply.
Possible explanation: Large or unusual amounts can trigger additional checks or declines.
General information: Education payments often have their own rules and preferred channels.
